posts.title: Make a highlight reel from your LosslessCut projects
posts.description: If you've marked the best moments of many videos as segments in LosslessCut, this script joins them all into one highlight reel, without exporting each file first.

posts.title: 2026 Mount Aso, Japan helicopter accident
posts.description: Probably my scariest travel experience ever happened right here, on the volcano of Mount Aso in southwestern Japan, and it's not what you think. Please help me solve this riddle of an experience which I cannot explain.

posts.title: TinyShare — TypeScript-first social share helper
posts.description: TinyShare is a tiny, TypeScript-first helper that builds social sharing URLs and opens share windows. It’s a single-file, dependency-free, programmatic alternative to DOM-bound sharer libraries.
